discussion.text: Welcome — this board is where John, Nickie, and Johnny plan Mom & Dad's visit together with the agent team. Core window if they arrive on Sunday, Dec 20, 2026: departure Sunday, Jan 3, 2027 (14 nights), with Christmas Day (Fri Dec 25) and New Year's Day (Fri Jan 1) inside the trip. Route is now resolved: San Jose only, all three hosts are in San Jose. Parents fly from SGN (Ho Chi Minh City); flight times are not yet chosen — see D3 for checked options. No price appears on this board without a source and a check date.

Route update from John: San Jose 3-4 days, then NYC, Niagara Falls and Pennsylvania. Re-priced for 2 adults as separate tickets per leg (legs are days apart, so separate tickets carry no missed-connection risk between them). Best comfort set is about $4,054 total; budget set about $3,121. The single-ticket multi-city quotes were worse and the cheapest forced a 42h45m first leg, so we do not recommend them. Full options are on D3; the East Coast skeleton is on D4.
